name: Inkpen
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 1 sp; Weight —
Category Adventuring Gear
Description
This is a wooden stylus with a metal tip that retains a small amount of ink after you dip it in a vial of ink.
